topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This topic introduces the lecture framework and outlines the core learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how genetic clonal selection and epigenetic chromatin modifications contribute to cancer initiation and evolutionary progression.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchy and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the relationship between normal tissue stem cell hierarchies and cancer development through theoretical models and experimental evidence across tissues.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion, inflammation, and stromal dependence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address how external promotional factors, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stromal interactions facilitate tumor progression and maintenance.

topics.label: Methods for investigating tumor evolution and spatial biology
topics.groupedBecause: This topic outlines the experimental sequencing techniques, computational modeling, and spatial omics technologies used to study tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Integrated multifactorial model of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This topic synthesizes how mutational burden, cell-of-origin properties, and microenvironmental conditions interact to drive cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This topic provides the lecture's closing remarks and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
